g_policy.reason: The 'if the user declines' field says closing the card makes replies slower than normal for the rest of the day, so declining leaves the app worse than before the offer.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of priority routing (queue_priority), which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event, returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry. No chat content is used.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The slowdown on decline is a problem for g_policy. It touches only queue priority, which is a cost-bearing resource where a new cap is allowed, and no other free feature is removed.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the profile menu drawer (s09), a sheet over the non-chat Profile screen, and s09 is rated safe.

c1_revealed_value.reason: The app charges for priority routing (m02, l02 'Priority routing for faster replies'), so the reward gives a resource the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: Claims about Janitor+ selling priority routing (s02.e06) and the permanent Upgrade entry in the profile menu (s09.e31) are supported. The card, the slowdown and the copy are the proposal's own additions, and the cost remark is a prediction.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The 'subscribers' field says subscribers already have priority routing and never see the card, so paying users are not shown the offer.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 60 minutes and is capped at 2 per day, so it is a sample that ends. Priority routing is already sold by the app, so it isn't taking something the app doesn't sell.

c5_moment.reason: The card is on the profile menu, a persistent surface the user chooses to open, right after they looked at the plan, so it doesn't interrupt a task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The unit is a play-to-earn sponsored game, and the reward turns on only after the play is verified. The trigger, returning from the Upgrade entry, is an app event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry in the profile menu (s09.e31) and Janitor+'s priority routing benefit, which only make sense in this app.

other_concern: The Upgrade destination screen was not observed, so the 'returns without subscribing' trigger rests on an unseen flow. The proposal's flow also ends on My Chats, which differs from the menu-card setting.
